description: Home option tree programs.agents.<name> for the 5 base CLIs: claude-code, pi, opencode, gemini-cli, antigravity-cli. Endpoint wrappers are NOT entries. Each entry: per-platform delivery channel (brew on darwin, pkgs.master on NixOS; keep rationale comments), skillDir, herdr integration id, ACP id, default gate floor|ai|off. claude-code = floor agent (always on; brew cask claude-code@latest on every Mac). Non-floor agents gate on resolved features.ai (devboxes lose pi/opencode). Policy-only agents (agy) default off; firefly policy flips programs.agents.antigravity-cli.enable. darwin/nixos install modules read config.user.programs.agents resolved set. herdr integrations and agentSkills.roots derived from roster; no separate drift guard.
title: Agent roster module (programs.agents)
